verdict.rationale: Ollama documents its REST API with copy-and-run curl request guidance and serves an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec on docs.ollama.com, so a machine-readable API reference with example requests exists. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or in-browser 'try it' console. The 404s on ollama.com OpenAPI paths are only a path difference from docs.ollama.com, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer or playground, runnable examples executable from the reference itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: docs.ollama.com serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Ollama API" whose description reads "OpenAPI specification for the Ollama HTTP API"
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
